messages:
alex: Heads-up: slight change to this week's release train -> shifting mainline cutoff to Thu 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Partial freeze for model-serving infra starts Wed 13:00 PT. Details below.

alex: TL;DR:
- Cutoff: Thu 17:00 PT
- Partial freeze (no infra-breaking changes): Wed 13:00 PT
- Full freeze for critical-path (canaries, rollout gating): Thu 12:00 PT
- Deprecation: removing legacy /v1/batch endpoint on April 15 (customers contacted)

alex: Why: recent runtime-2.4 rollout showed intermittent KV-cache evictions at high concurrency; need a short window to validate kernel swap and new autoscaler config. No broad product changes planned during freeze.

maria: re canaries — what's the plan for canary percentage? I can run a targeted rerun of the embeddings suite.

liam: +1 to more canary traffic. Suggest 3-stage: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with health checks (latency, errors, kv_eviction) at each step.

chad: @ops-bot: can you queue the canary deploy for runtime-2.4 -> pool-a now so QA can kick off?

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/canary-2.4 -> pool-a. Started at 1819000123. CI checks: smoke, perf, seatbelt. Link: https://ci.internal/job/1819000123

maria: Running embeddings regression suite now. Will paste results in ~30m.

alex: If embeddings regression shows >0.5% quality drop we'll pause rollout and revert to 2.3. Rollback command if needed:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model runtime-2.4 --to-tag runtime-2.3
```

sara: @alex are there any customers on Dedicated whose SLA we need to notify? I can ping account-ops and CS.

alex: Yes, notify customers with dedicated pools in us-west-2 and eu-central. Use the template in #customer-success/dedicated-notifs and CC account-ops.

maria: embeddings results: minor throughput dip ~4% at 512 seq, quality stable (<0.2% drift). No blocking issues from model QA.

liam: Canary 1% -> 5% completed, p95 latency stable, KV eviction metric down ~40% after kernel swap.

chad: rolling to 25% now. tagging rollout id: rtf-2026-03-25-01

deploy-bot: Rollout rtf-2026-03-25-01: stage 1 complete (1%). Stage 2 (5%) complete. Stage 3 (25%) in progress. Logs: https://deploys.internal/rtf-2026-03-25-01

ops-bot: Alert: autoscaler observed spike to 180% of baseline during test ramp at 11:04. Adjusted scale threshold +5%. Notified eng-oncall.

alex: Good catch. Monitoring closely. If any service crosses 2.0x baseline for >5m we abort and roll back.

maria: all good on embeddings. LGTM from model QA. No regression signals in the evaluation harness.

liam: 25% rollback check OK, proceeding to full rollout. ETA to 100% ~ 45m barring incidents.

chad: Note: full freeze lifts Mon 00:00 PT; please avoid landing large infra changes until next cycle even after freeze lifts. We need 48h stabilization window.

sara: sent customer notific to affected accounts referencing the deprecation timeline and support contacts.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short bulletin to #eng-releases with final outcome and capture any follow-ups. If we hit any incident we'll open a postmortem template in #postmortems.

maria: :rocket:

liam: ping me if anything spikes; I'll hold off on non-urgent merges.

chad: keeping an eye on canaries. will update once full rollout completes.

ops-bot: Rollout rtf-2026-03-25-01: 3/3 stages complete. 100% rollout succeeded at 1819004399. Metrics: latency delta +0.6% p50, p95 +1.1%, kv_eviction down 42%.

alex: Outcome: rollout successful. No customer-facing incidents. We kept the partial freeze to Wed-Thu window; deprecated /v1/batch notice sent. Closing thread — thanks team.
